mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) above a 3% quarter-over-quarter growth rate signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS QoQ > 3% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months, and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% month-over-month and real final sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter, it signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 10% and RSAFS QoQ > 2%, and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals tightening supply and monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS increases during a late-cycle expansion, and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
